body.p: When installed in Oxygen XML Web Author 27.1 or newer, plugins or frameworks can contain a folder named ai-positron-actions where custom AI actions are automatically loaded from by the AI Positron.
The ai-positron-actions folder can contain an extra file named excluded-action-ids.txt, which can list all action IDs (on a line-by-line basis) that should be filtered out of the AI Positron UI.

To discover an action's ID, after you invoke an AI action, you can use the Actions drop-down menu in the chat view (or press / in the chat input text area if you are using the AI Positron for Web Author) and choose to export the conversation to JSON. The JSON exported representation of the action should contain the action ID.
